SECTION 01 — WHY IT WINS
Three things every other case gets wrong

Not adjectives. Three measurements, each one taken in a lab and published in full.

12
ft
01
It cracks on the first real drop

Slim usually means solid plastic corners that pass the shock straight into the frame. These corners are a honeycomb of collapsing air cells — they crush, absorb, and spring back. 26 drops onto concrete from 12 feet, no phone damage.

TYPICAL SLIM CASE
6–8 ft
CASIFY
12 ft
1400
g
02
The magnet lets go when you need it

"MagSafe compatible" is a sticker, not a spec. We publish pull force. Eighteen N52 magnets in a full ring hold 1,400 g, so your phone stays on the vent mount over a speed bump — and still charges at the full Qi2 25W.

CATEGORY AVERAGE
800–900 g
CASIFY
1,400 g
36
mo
03
Clear turns yellow by month four

Cheap TPU oxidises under UV and skin oil — that's why your last clear case looked like an old fingernail. This back is UV-stable polycarbonate with a bonded top coat: no measurable colour shift after the equivalent of three years outdoors.

STANDARD TPU
Yellow by month 4
CASIFY
No shift at 36 mo
